title: DevOps
tagline: Automate builds, deployments, and infrastructure with modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
description: Learn how modern engineering teams ship software faster and more reliably. This program takes you from Linux and Git fundamentals through containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code — the same core skills used by DevOps and platform teams in production.
outcomes: Automate build, test, and deployment pipelines with CI/CD tools
Containerize and orchestrate applications with Docker and Kubernetes
Provision and manage cloud infrastructure as code
Monitor, troubleshoot, and respond to issues in production systems

topics: Capstone: ship a full CI/CD pipeline for a live app

projects: Build a CI/CD pipeline that auto-deploys a full-stack app on every push
Containerize and deploy a microservice to a Kubernetes cluster

faqs.q: Do I need prior Linux experience?
faqs.a: No — we start from the fundamentals in week one. Basic programming familiarity helps but isn't required.

faqs.q: Will I get hands-on cloud practice?
faqs.a: Yes — all infrastructure modules use real AWS environments, not simulations.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
